data.additional_information:
Mechanical Design Engineer (Mechatronics & Environmental Systems)
Location: Bangalore
Role Type: Full-time / Research Engineer
________________________________________
Role Overview
We are looking for a Mechanical Design Engineer with strong exposure to mechatronic systems and real-world environmental constraints. The role involves designing robust mechanical systems that integrate electronics and RF components, with a focus on thermal management, EMI/EMC considerations, and field deployment reliability.
This role is well suited for candidates who enjoy working at the intersection of mechanical, electrical, and system engineering, translating complex requirements into practical hardware.
________________________________________
Key Responsibilities
Mechanical System Design
• Design and develop mechanical enclosures and assemblies for integrated electronic systems
• Work on ruggedization for real-world environments (temperature, vibration, dust, moisture)
• Optimize for size, weight, and structural integrity
• Select materials based on thermal, structural, and environmental requirements
________________________________________
Mechatronic Integration
• Integrate electronics, RF modules, antennas, and power systems into compact mechanical designs
• Collaborate with electrical and RF teams for layout, grounding, and shielding strategies
• Design for cabling, connectors, and serviceability
• Ensure mechanical designs support system-level performance
________________________________________
Thermal Design & Analysis
• Perform thermal analysis and heat dissipation design
• Design passive and active cooling solutions (heat sinks, airflow, conduction paths)
• Evaluate system performance across wide temperature ranges
• Use tools such as ANSYS / SolidWorks Simulation / equivalent
________________________________________
EMI/EMC & Environmental Considerations
• Design enclosures with EMI/EMC shielding and grounding considerations
• Work with RF teams to minimize interference and coupling issues
• Ensure compliance with environmental and electromagnetic constraints
• Implement sealing and protection strategies (IP-rated designs where required)
________________________________________
Prototyping & Testing
• Develop rapid prototypes using machining / 3D printing
• Conduct fitment, structural, and environmental testing
• Iterate designs based on test results and field feedback
________________________________________
Required Skills & Background
• Strong fundamentals in:
o Mechanical design and engineering principles
o Material selection and structural analysis
• Experience with CAD tools:
o SolidWorks / Fusion 360 / CATIA / equivalent
• Understanding of:
o Thermal management in electronic systems
o EMI/EMC basics and shielding concepts
• Exposure to mechatronic system design and integration
________________________________________
Preferred (Not Mandatory)
• Experience with:
o Ruggedized or field-deployable systems
o Electronics packaging and enclosure design
• Familiarity with:
o IP ratings, environmental standards, and testing protocols
• Hands-on experience with:
o Prototyping tools, machining, or fabrication workflows
________________________________________
What We Value
• Strong systems thinking across mechanical + electrical domains
• Ability to translate complex constraints into clean design solutions
• Bias toward practical, buildable designs
• Ownership and ability to iterate quickly in a product-driven environment
________________________________________
Ideal Candidate Profile
• MTech / BTech / PhD / final-year students in:
o Mechanical Engineering / Mechatronics / Product Design
• Or candidates with equivalent hands-on experience in system-level mechanical design
________________________________________
What You’ll Work On
• Mechanical systems for advanced electronic platforms
• Design challenges involving:
o Thermal management
o EMI/EMC-aware enclosures
o Compact and rugged system integration
• End-to-end development from concept to field validation
________________________________________
Outcome Expectations (Initial Phase)
• Deliver validated mechanical designs and prototypes
• Enable robust integration of electronics and RF subsystems
• Establish thermal and environmental validation workflows
________________________________________
This role offers an opportunity to work on challenging, multidisciplinary systems where mechanical design directly impacts system performance and reliability.
